sentences.text: Heard Sri Vivek Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anuj Singh, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the records.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 176 of 2020, under Sections 406, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 I.P.C, Police Station Kamrauli, District Amethi.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 19.10.2020 against three persons, including the applicant, alleging that the accused persons induced the informant and various other persons for making investment in Eye Vision India Credit Cooperation Society Limited and the amount invested was not refunded.

sentences.text: 4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

sentences.text: It is specifically stated in the affidavit filed in support of the bail application that the applicant is neither director nor any other position holder in the society in question and he is not even an agent of the same.

6. The applicant's criminal history of 75 cases has been disclosed in paragraph 12 of the affidavit, all of which relate to transactions of the aforesaid society and in 41 of which the applicant has been granted bail.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant claims that he does not hold any principal position in the company/society in question and that the applicant has been granted bail in several other cases of similar nature, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail in the present case also.
8. Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Preeti.
